operations.details: Verified official OS Terrain 50 Grid data technical specification for ASCII raster structure.
Official OS specification states the ASCII grid data header occupies the first six rows.
Official OS specification states ncols=200 and nrows=200 for Terrain50 10km grid tiles.
Official OS specification states cellsize=50m and 200 pixels per row.
Official OS specification states each data row reads west to east.
Official OS specification states each successive row begins 50m south of the previous row.
Official OS specification states each Terrain50 height value is calculated from the centre of its 50m pixel.
OS Terrain50 technical specification identifies 10km tiles by National Grid reference of their south-west corner.
GDAL AAIGrid documentation confirms built-in Arc/Info ASCII Grid reading with georeferencing and optional .prj projection support.
Rasterio documentation confirms all_touched=True selects every raster pixel touched by the polygon rather than only center-inside pixels.
Locked sparse-read convention: physical file line = 6 header rows + 1-based data row; token = 1-based west-to-east column.
Locked centre northing formula: yllcorner + (nrows - data_row + 0.5) * 50m.
Locked centre easting formula: xllcorner + (token - 0.5) * 50m.
TQ39 south-west tile origin resolves to EPSG:27700 easting 530000, northing 190000.

Explicitly guards against off-by-six bugs: physical ASCII file line numbers include six header rows, while data row numbers do not.
